subject: [PATCH v2 2/2] selftests/nfsd: add lockd netlink configuration tests

2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch adds a new test to the NFS daemon (nfsd) selftests suite, specifically targeting the lockd netlink configuration interface. The test covers the LOCKD_CMD_SERVER_SET and SERVER_GET commands, ensuring that each attribute can be set individually without requiring a grace time. Additionally, it verifies that an empty SERVER_SET is treated as a no-op, and that settings are applied per network namespace. The patch also includes plumbing to support the lockd family in the generic-netlink interface.
